opportunities.title: Scientist/Engineer 'SC' (Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science)
opportunities.description: ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB) invites applications for the post of Scientist/Engineer "SC" in Level 10 of Pay Matrix for engineering graduates in Electronics, Mechanical and Computer Science disciplines.
opportunities.shortDescription: Level 10 Central Government Gazetted post for BE/B.Tech graduates in Electronics, Mechanical and CS.
opportunities.eligibility: BE/B.Tech or equivalent in First Class with an aggregate minimum of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84/10.
opportunities.experienceRequirements: Freshers eligible. No prior experience required.

opportunities.title: Combined Graduate Level Examination (SSC CGL 2026)
opportunities.description: Staff Selection Commission invites online applications for recruitment to Group "B" and Group "C" posts in various Ministries/Departments/Organizations of the Government of India.
opportunities.shortDescription: Recruitment for Assistant Section Officer, Inspector, Sub-Inspector, and Auditor posts.
opportunities.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University or equivalent. Final year students are eligible provided proof of passing is available by cutoff.

opportunities.title: Senior Technical Assistant-B (STA-B) Recruitment
opportunities.description: DRDO invites applications from meritorious Indian nationals for the post of Senior Technical Assistant-B (STA-B) under Centre for Personnel Talent Management (CEPTAM-11).
opportunities.shortDescription: Technical research assistant openings for BSc and Engineering Diploma holders.
opportunities.eligibility: B.Sc degree in Science or 3-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology from a recognized Institution.

opportunities.title: Probationary Officer / Management Trainee (CRP PO/MT-XIV)
opportunities.description: Recruitment for Probationary Officers and Management Trainees in 11 participating Public Sector Undertaking banks across India.
opportunities.shortDescription: Banking sector officer openings across Punjab National Bank, Canara Bank, Bank of Baroda, and more.
opportunities.eligibility: A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognized by the Govt. Of India.

opportunities.title: Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical & Electrical) Examination 2026
opportunities.description: Recruitment of Junior Engineers in CPWD, MES, Central Water Commission, and Border Roads Organisation (BRO).
opportunities.shortDescription: Technical engineering cadre openings for Degree and Diploma engineers.
opportunities.eligibility: Degree or Diploma in Civil / Electrical / Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute.
opportunities.experienceRequirements: 2 years experience required only for Diploma holders in CPWD/MES. Fresher degree holders eligible.

opportunities.title: Scientific Officer Selection (OCES / DGFS 2026)
opportunities.description: Recruitment of engineering graduates and science postgraduates as Scientific Officers (Group A) through BARC Training Schools.
opportunities.shortDescription: Premier nuclear science and engineering career with Department of Atomic Energy.
opportunities.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engineering) with minimum 60% aggregate marks, or valid GATE score.

opportunities.title: Non-Technical Popular Categories (RRB NTPC 2026)
opportunities.description: Ministry of Railways invites applications for Graduate and Undergraduate level posts including Station Master, Goods Train Manager, and Senior Clerk.
opportunities.shortDescription: Pan-India Indian Railways recruitment across Level 2, 3, 5 and 6 posts.
opportunities.eligibility: 12th pass for undergraduate posts; University degree for graduate posts.

opportunities.title: Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales) - Clerk Recruitment
opportunities.description: State Bank of India invites applications from eligible Indian citizens for appointment as Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) in clerical cadre in State Bank of India.
opportunities.shortDescription: Over 8,000 clerical positions in India largest public sector commercial bank.
opportunities.eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University or equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government.

opportunities.title: Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT) Recruitment 2026
opportunities.description: Government of NCT of Delhi invites applications for TGT in Computer Science, Mathematics, Natural Science, Social Science, and English under Directorate of Education.
opportunities.shortDescription: Teaching posts in Delhi Government schools with GP 4600.
opportunities.eligibility: Bachelor Degree (Honours/Pass) in relevant subject + B.Ed + CTET Paper II qualified from CBSE.
opportunities.experienceRequirements: Teaching experience preferred but not mandatory.

opportunities.title: Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination 2027
opportunities.description: Recruitment to the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), Indian Foreign Service (IFS) and other Group A & B Central Services.
opportunities.shortDescription: Premier civil services examination for administrative leadership roles.
opportunities.eligibility: A candidate must hold a Graduate degree of any recognized University in India.

opportunities.title: Post Matric Scholarship Schemes for Minorities
opportunities.description: Financial assistance for meritorious students belonging to economically weaker sections of minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi).
opportunities.shortDescription: Covers admission, course fee and maintenance allowance for Class 11 to PhD students.
opportunities.stipend: Up to ₹20,000 / year + Tuition fee waiver
opportunities.eligibility: Secured minimum 50% marks in previous examination and family income not exceeding ₹2.00 Lakh per annum.

opportunities.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree/Diploma)
opportunities.organization: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
opportunities.description: Empowers young women pursuing technical education in AICTE approved institutions with an annual grant.
opportunities.shortDescription: ₹50,000 per annum for tuition, equipment and books for female technical students.
opportunities.eligibility: Admitted to 1st year or 2nd year (lateral entry) of technical degree/diploma. Family income less than ₹8 Lakh/annum. Max two girl children per family.

opportunities.title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
opportunities.organization: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
opportunities.description: Financial support to meritorious students from low-income families to meet their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
opportunities.shortDescription: ₹12,000 per year at Graduation level and ₹20,000 per year at Post-Graduation level.
opportunities.eligibility: Above 80th percentile in Class 12 board examination and pursuing regular degree course. Family income under ₹4.5 Lakh/annum.

opportunities.title: Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE) - INSPIRE Scheme
opportunities.description: Encourages talented youth to undertake higher education in science-intensive programmes by providing handsome scholarships and mentorship.
opportunities.shortDescription: ₹80,000 per annum for students pursuing B.Sc, B.S., and Int. M.Sc in natural & basic sciences.
opportunities.eligibility: Top 1% in Class 12 board examination pursuing B.Sc / B.S. / Int. M.Sc in basic natural sciences or top rankers in JEE/NEET.

opportunities.title: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Wards of Ex-Servicemen (PMSS)
opportunities.description: Promotes technical and post-graduate education for dependent widows and wards of Ex-Servicemen/Ex-Coast Guard personnel.
opportunities.shortDescription: ₹36,000/year for girls, ₹30,000/year for boys admitted to professional degree courses.
opportunities.eligibility: Wards of deceased or retired armed forces personnel with minimum 60% marks in Class 12 or graduation.

opportunities.title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students
opportunities.organization: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
opportunities.description: Financial encouragement for students with benchmark disabilities pursuing higher technical education in recognized institutions.
opportunities.shortDescription: ₹50,000 per annum for differently-abled technical students.
opportunities.eligibility: Specially-abled student having disability not less than 40%. Admitted to 1st year or 2nd year (lateral) of technical degree/diploma. Family income < ₹8 Lakh.

opportunities.title: Post-Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
opportunities.description: Promotes girl education and compensates direct costs of higher education especially for girls who happen to be the only child in the family.
opportunities.shortDescription: ₹36,200 per annum for 2 years for single girl children in non-professional PG programs.
opportunities.eligibility: Girl student admitted to 1st year of Master degree programme in any recognized university and who is the only child of her parents.

opportunities.title: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme for Orphans and Wards of Armed Forces
opportunities.organization: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
opportunities.description: Financial support to orphans, children whose both parents died due to COVID-19, and wards of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action.
opportunities.shortDescription: ₹50,000 per annum for technical education tuition and equipment.
opportunities.eligibility: Candidate should be Orphan / both parents died due to COVID / ward of Armed forces martyred in action. Enrolled in AICTE approved institution.

opportunities.title: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (PMS-SC)
opportunities.organization: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
opportunities.description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students at post-matriculation stage.
opportunities.shortDescription: Complete academic allowance and course fees for SC category students in higher education.
opportunities.stipend: Up to ₹13,500 / year + Full fee reimbursement
opportunities.eligibility: Belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC). Family income not exceeding ₹2.50 Lakh per annum.
opportunities.sourceName: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

opportunities.title: National Fellowship for Other Backward Classes (NFOBC)
opportunities.organization: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / UGC
opportunities.description: Fellowship to OBC students for pursuing M.Phil. and Ph.D. degrees in Sciences, Humanities, Social Sciences & Engineering.
opportunities.shortDescription: Junior Research Fellowship of ₹37,000/month + HRA for OBC research scholars.
opportunities.eligibility: Must belong to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and qualified in UGC-NET / CSIR-NET. Enrolled in full-time M.Phil / Ph.D.

opportunities.title: NITI Aayog Internship Scheme (Winter / Spring 2026)
opportunities.description: Unpaid experiential learning opportunity allowing young students to closely engage with public policy formulating processes, data analytics, and policy briefs.
opportunities.shortDescription: Work closely with Verticals, Policy Advisors and Specialists at NITI Bhawan, New Delhi.
opportunities.stipend: Certificate of Experience provided (Unpaid Public Service Scheme)
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate students who have completed 2nd year (>= 85% in Class 12) or Postgraduate/PhD scholars with >= 70% in graduation.

opportunities.title: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) Internship Programme
opportunities.description: Offered in two terms annually to expose interns to India’s foreign policy, bilateral relations, multilateral engagements, and diplomatic communication.
opportunities.shortDescription: Diplomatic relations and international policy internship with ₹10,000 monthly honorarium.
opportunities.eligibility: Graduate degree from a recognized university at the time of applying, or students in final year of undergraduate course.

opportunities.title: Reserve Bank of India Summer Placement Programme 2027
opportunities.description: Prestige summer placement for domestic and international students in areas of banking, macroeconomic policy, fin-tech, and econometric modeling.
opportunities.shortDescription: High-stipend central banking internship for management, commerce and economics postgraduates.
opportunities.eligibility: Students pursuing Post-Graduate / Integrated 5-year Courses in Management / Statistics / Law / Commerce / Economics / Econometrics / Banking / Finance.
opportunities.experienceRequirements: Enrolled in 1st year of Master/MBA program.

opportunities.title: Digital India Internship Scheme (Autumn Cohort)
opportunities.description: Interns are engaged in Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Forensics, E-Governance architectures, and semiconductor ecosystem policy.
opportunities.shortDescription: Hands-on tech internship for engineering and technology students in New Delhi.
opportunities.eligibility: Indian students pursuing B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / M.E. / MCA in CSE, IT, Electronics with minimum 60% marks in aggregate.

opportunities.title: DPIIT Internship Scheme for Industrial Policy & Startups
opportunities.organization: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
opportunities.description: Experience in startup valuation, intellectual property rights (IPR), FDI promotion, and national manufacturing logistics.
opportunities.shortDescription: Industrial policy and Startup India operational internship.
opportunities.eligibility: Students pursuing Under Graduate / Post Graduate / Research Degrees from recognized universities.

opportunities.title: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF Cycle 13)
opportunities.description: Designed for improving the quality of research in higher educational institutions in India, attracting best talent to doctoral programmes in IITs/IISc.
opportunities.shortDescription: ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 per month + ₹2 Lakh/year research contingency grant.
opportunities.eligibility: Direct Entry or Lateral Entry Ph.D. scholars in PMRF Granting Institutes with CGPA >= 8.0 or valid GATE score >= 650.

opportunities.title: CSIR Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) & Research Associate (RA)
opportunities.organization: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)
opportunities.description: Provides research grants to bright researchers to work on scientific frontiers in national laboratories and university departments.
opportunities.shortDescription: Postgraduate scientific fellowship with ₹42,000 / month stipend + HRA.
opportunities.eligibility: M.Sc./B.Tech. with minimum 55% marks and at least two years of post-M.Sc./B.Tech. research experience demonstrated by publications.

opportunities.title: Ramanujan Fellowship for Outstanding Scientists Abroad / Returning
opportunities.organization: Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB - ANRF)
opportunities.description: Attracts brilliant Indian scientists and engineers from all over the world to take up scientific research in India.
opportunities.shortDescription: ₹1,35,000 per month consolidated fellowship + ₹7.00 Lakh/year research grant.
opportunities.eligibility: Ph.D. in Science/Engineering with proven high-impact research contributions. Below 40 years of age.

opportunities.title: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan Post-Doctoral Fellowship in Humanities & Social Sciences
opportunities.description: Opportunity to carry out advanced research in Indian languages, literature, culture, history, and social dynamics.
opportunities.shortDescription: ₹50,000 / month fellowship for humanities and language scholars.
opportunities.eligibility: Awarded Ph.D. degree in Humanities, Languages, or Social Sciences within past 3 years.
opportunities.experienceRequirements: Published research papers in peer-reviewed journals.

opportunities.title: Gandhi Fellowship (Cohort 18 - Public System Transformation)
opportunities.organization: Piramal School of Leadership / NITI Aayog Aspirational Districts
opportunities.description: Two-year intensive residential program designed to develop grassroots leadership by working with District Magistrates and Education Officers.
opportunities.shortDescription: Grassroots public governance and education transformation fellowship.
opportunities.eligibility: Graduate or Postgraduate in any discipline with deep passion for social change and public leadership.
opportunities.experienceRequirements: Freshers or up to 2 years work experience.

opportunities.title: Engineering Services Examination 2027 (ESE / IES)
opportunities.description: National competitive exam to recruit engineers for Indian Railway Service of Mechanical Engineers, Indian Defence Service of Engineers, Central Power Engineering Service, etc.
opportunities.shortDescription: National level engineering examination for Class 1 Central Government Services.
opportunities.eligibility: Degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics & Telecom) from a recognized University.

opportunities.title: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE 2027)
opportunities.organization: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (Organizing Institute)
opportunities.description: National examination that tests comprehensive understanding of various undergraduate subjects in engineering and technology for admission to Master programs and PSU recruitments.
opportunities.shortDescription: National gateway examination for M.Tech admissions and PSU recruitment (IOCL, NTPC, ONGC, BARC).
opportunities.eligibility: Candidates currently studying in 3rd or higher years of undergraduate degree, or already completed degree in Engineering / Technology / Architecture / Science / Commerce / Arts.

opportunities.title: UGC National Eligibility Test (UGC NET December 2026 Cycle)
opportunities.description: Determines eligibility of Indian nationals for Award of Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and appointment as Assistant Professor in Indian universities and colleges.
opportunities.shortDescription: National certification exam for University professorship and PhD admissions.
opportunities.eligibility: Master's Degree or equivalent with at least 55% marks (50% for OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwD) from UGC recognized universities.

opportunities.title: Combined Defence Services Examination (CDS Exam I, 2027)
opportunities.description: Recruitment of Commissioned Officers in Indian Military Academy (IMA), Indian Naval Academy (INA), Air Force Academy (AFA), and Officers Training Academy (OTA).
opportunities.shortDescription: Direct officer commissioning for Army, Navy, and Air Force for graduates.
opportunities.eligibility: For IMA/OTA: Degree of a recognized University; For INA: Degree in Engineering; For AFA: Degree with Physics & Math at 10+2 level or Bachelor of Engineering.

opportunities.title: National Defence Academy & Naval Academy Examination (NDA & NA I, 2027)
opportunities.description: Admission to Army, Navy and Air Force wings of the NDA for 155th Course and for 117th Indian Naval Academy Course (INAC).
opportunities.shortDescription: Premier military academy admission for 12th pass students.
opportunities.eligibility: For Army: 12th Class pass of 10+2 pattern; For Air Force & Navy: 12th Class pass with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
